prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1158; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. They reported immediate pain in the right shoulder with restricted range of motion, particularly with overhead reaching and internal rotation. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior and lateral shoulder, mild swelling, and reduced active abduction. Neurovascular status of the upper extremity was intact. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture and showed no acute bony abnormality.

Over the course of eight outpatient visits, treatment consisted of a structured physical therapy program focused on passive and active-assisted range of motion, progressive strengthening of the rotator cuff and scapular stabilizers, and manual therapy to address soft tissue restriction. Anti-inflammatory medication was used for pain control, and activity modifications were recommended. The patient's pain decreased steadily, and range of motion improved to near functional limits by the final visit. Residual mild discomfort with heavy lifting persists. A home exercise program was provided, and the patient was discharged to self-directed care with instructions to return if symptoms worsen.
